data.name: Tushar Kinhikar
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Tushar Kinhikar has made a big mark in cricket. With 272 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 79*, with an average of 16.59 and a quick strike rate of 144.06. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 290 sixes and 294 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 138.5 overs, taking 56 wickets at an economy rate of 12.37. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
